name: AICTE Pragati Scholarship for Girl Students (₹50,000/Year)
ministry: All India Council for Technical Education (AICTE)
benefitType: Direct Bank Cash for Laptop, Books & Fees
benefitSummary: ₹50,000 per year for every year of study credited directly via DBT for girl students in Diploma or Degree (Engineering, Pharmacy, Management, Computer Applications).
statutoryRule: Up to 2 girl students per family with annual household income below ₹8,00,000 are eligible.
commonRejectionTrap: Applying under general NSP tab instead of 'AICTE Pragati' section on scholarships.gov.in.
criteriaList: Must be a girl student admitted to 1st year or 2nd year (lateral entry) of a technical Degree or Diploma.
Family annual income from all sources must be less than ₹8,00,000.
Maximum 2 girls per family can claim this ₹50,000/year grant.
documents: Valid Income Certificate (< ₹8 Lakh/yr with RD Number)
Tuition Fee Receipt for Current Academic Year
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Visit scholarships.gov.in and complete One-Time Registration (OTR) using Aadhaar OTP.
Step 2: Download NSP OTR App on Android and complete Face Authentication.
Step 3: Login to NSP → Click 'Apply for Scholarship' → Choose 'AICTE Pragati Scholarship Scheme for Girl Students'.
Step 4: Upload PDF scans of Income Certificate, Bonafide Letter, and Fee Receipt (each under 200 KB).
Step 5: Submit online and hand 1 printed copy to your College Scholarship Nodal Officer for Institute e-Verification.
physicalCounter: College AICTE Nodal Desk + Any CSC / Cyber-Café
cscSteps: Login to scholarships.gov.in → Student OTR → Select AICTE Pragati Scheme → Upload RD Income Certificate & Bonafide → Trigger Institute KYC.

name: PM Surya Ghar: Muft Bijli Yojana (₹78,000 Direct Solar Cash Grant)
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefitType: ₹78,000 Upfront Capital Subsidy + 300 Units Free Electricity
benefitSummary: Central Government credits up to ₹78,000 direct subsidy into your bank account within 30 days of rooftop solar installation + gives 300 units/month free power (amortized ₹33,600/yr benefit).
statutoryRule: ₹30,000/kW up to 2 kW + ₹18,000 for 3rd kW (Total ₹78,000 non-repayable grant). Remaining amount available as collateral-free 7% bank loan.
commonRejectionTrap: Installing panels through unverified local contractors instead of MNRE portal-registered vendors.
criteriaList: Indian citizen with an electricity meter connection in their name.
House roof suitable for 1 kW to 3 kW solar panel installation.
Must not have claimed an earlier MNRE rooftop solar subsidy.
documents: Latest Electricity Bill (with Consumer/RR Account Number)
Cancelled Cheque or Bank Passbook (for ₹78,000 DBT credit)
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Go to pmsuryaghar.gov.in and click 'Apply for Rooftop Solar'.
Step 2: Select your State, Electricity Company (BESCOM/HESCOM/etc.), and enter your Consumer Account Number.
Step 3: Receive automatic Technical Feasibility Approval from your DISCOM online.
Step 4: Select a registered vendor on the portal and install the plant.
Step 5: Upload net-meter details and cancelled cheque—₹78,000 subsidy hits your bank account within 30 days.
physicalCounter: Nearest Post Office / CSC / ESCOM Subdivision Office
cscSteps: pmsuryaghar.gov.in → Register Consumer RR Number → Apply Feasibility → Upload Bank Cancelled Cheque for ₹78,000 DBT.

name: Construction & Unorganized Worker Board Hidden Grants (₹60,000 Marriage + ₹30,000 Education)
deadlineLabel: ⏳ Annual Renewal Window Ends in 2 Days
ministry: Building & Other Construction Workers Welfare Board (KBOCWWB)
benefitType: Hidden Multi-Benefit Cash Vault (Education + Marriage + Medical + Bus Pass)
benefitSummary: Registered labour card holders unlock 12+ hidden cash payouts: ₹60,000 for marriage (self or 2 children), ₹11,000–₹30,000/yr children's scholarship, ₹50,000 maternity cash, and free toolkits.
statutoryRule: Open to 55+ worker categories (masons, electricians, plumbers, painters, carpenters, earth-movers, helpers) aged 18–60 who worked 90+ days in the past year.
commonRejectionTrap: Failing to renew the Labour e-Shram / KBOCWWB card once a year or applying >6 months after marriage/admission.
criteriaList: Age between 18 and 60 years working in construction, plumbing, painting, electrical, carpentry, or allied daily-wage work.
90-day employment certificate from contractor, Gram Panchayat PDO, or registered union.
Must hold an active KBOCWWB / State Labour Welfare Board ID card.
documents: 90-Days Work Certificate (signed by Panchayat PDO / Labour Inspector / Union)
College Admission Receipt or Marriage Registration Certificate (for respective grant)
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Open karbwwb.karnataka.gov.in or sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in.
Step 2: Register for smart Labour Card using Aadhaar OTP and 90-day work certificate.
Step 3: Once approved, open 'Scheme Benefits' tab → Select Education Assistance (Shikshana Sahayadhana) or Marriage Grant (Vivaha Sahayadhana).
Step 4: Upload supporting receipt and submit for direct DBT transfer.
physicalCounter: Taluk Labour Officer / GramaOne / CSC Centre
cscSteps: karbwwb.karnataka.gov.in → Login with Labour Registration No. → Select Welfare Benefit (Education/Marriage/Maternity) → Authenticate via Aadhaar OTP.

name: PMEGP 35% Non-Repayable Self-Employment Grant (Up to ₹17.5 Lakh Free Subsidy)
ministry: Ministry of MSME (Khadi & Village Industries Commission - KVIC)
benefitType: Up to 35% Non-Repayable Government Margin Money Grant
benefitSummary: Start any small shop, service unit (up to ₹20L), or manufacturing unit (up to ₹50L) and the Government pays 25% to 35% of the project cost as a FREE grant you never have to repay.
statutoryRule: SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities get 35% free subsidy in rural areas (25% in urban). No income ceiling! Minimum 8th standard pass for projects above ₹10L.
commonRejectionTrap: Applying for a working-capital-only trading business instead of a service/processing/manufacturing activity.
criteriaList: Any individual aged 18+ years starting a new micro-enterprise or service unit.
No family income ceiling applies under PMEGP rules.
Special category (Women, OBC, SC, ST, Minorities, Ex-Servicemen) receives maximum 35% rural / 25% urban grant.
documents: Caste / Special Category Certificate (for 35% subsidy tier)
Rural Area Certificate from Panchayat (if claiming 35% rural rate)
1-Page Project Report (auto-templates available on KVIC portal)
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Visit kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal and click 'Application for New Unit'.
Step 2: Select Implementing Agency (KVIC / KVIB / DIC) and choose a pre-made Project Profile from the portal library.
Step 3: Upload Aadhaar, Caste Certificate, and Educational Qualification.
Step 4: Complete the free online EDP (Entrepreneurship Development Programme) module after bank sanction to lock in your 35% grant.
physicalCounter: District Industries Centre (DIC) / KVIC Office / CSC
cscSteps: kviconline.gov.in/pmegpeportal → Fill Online Form → Choose DIC/KVIC → Attach Project Summary → Forward to Financing Bank.

name: State Free Laptop & Technical Kit Grant (₹35,000 Value)
deadlineLabel: 🔴 EXPIRED TODAY at 5:00 PM (Round-1 Closed • Late Condonation Open)
ministry: Dept of Collegiate & Technical Education / Social Welfare Dept
benefitType: Free Branded Laptop or ₹35,000 Direct Purchase Grant
benefitSummary: 1st-year Degree, Engineering, Polytechnic, and Medical students admitted through Govt Quota / CET from low-income families receive a free laptop or ₹35,000 DBT grant.
statutoryRule: Note: Round-1 portal closed today; students whose college admission/counselling was delayed can submit a Principal-attested Late Condonation Form for Round-2.
commonRejectionTrap: Missing Round-1 portal deadline without submitting a Principal-attested physical representation to the DCE Nodal Officer.
criteriaList: Must be enrolled in 1st-year Government or Govt-Quota seat in Degree, Engineering, Medical, or Polytechnic.
Annual family income ≤ ₹2,50,000 (SC/ST/OBC/EWS priority).
If Round-1 online date expired today, submit offline Condonation Application through College Principal.
documents: CET / Govt Quota Admission Order Copy
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Check dce.karnataka.gov.in / ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in for Laptop Scheme Notification.
Step 2: Since Round-1 closed today, print the Hakku Application & Condonation Letter from Tab 4.
Step 3: Get it signed by your College Principal and submit to the District Social Welfare / DCE Nodal Desk for Round-2 inclusion.
physicalCounter: College Principal Office / District Social Welfare Office
cscSteps: ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in → Check Laptop Grant Status → If Window Closed Today, Print Hakku Late-Condonation Form for College Nodal Officer.

name: PM SVANidhi Micro-Credit & Digital Cashback (₹1,200 Cashback + Working Capital)
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)
benefitType: 7% Interest Subsidy + ₹1,200 UPI Cashback + Collateral-Free Tranches (₹10k → ₹20k → ₹50k)
benefitSummary: For street vendors, tea stalls, vegetable sellers, tailors, and small kiosk owners: ₹10k–₹50k zero-collateral capital + 7% interest grant credited to bank + ₹1,200/yr UPI cashback.
statutoryRule: Even vendors without a formal vending certificate can apply via a simple Letter of Recommendation (LoR) generated online from the ULB/Municipality.
commonRejectionTrap: Not linking an active UPI QR code to claim the ₹100/month automatic cashback.
criteriaList: Any street vendor, hawker, home-food seller, cobbler, vegetable cart, or small service kiosk operator.
Aadhaar linked with active mobile number.
Eligible even without old municipal ID via instant Letter of Recommendation (LoR).
documents: Vending Certificate OR Online Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Visit pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in and click 'Apply Loan / LoR'.
Step 2: Verify mobile via OTP and select 'Vendor without ID (Request LoR)' if you don't have a street vendor card.
Step 3: Choose your preferred nearby nationalised bank; 7% interest subsidy is credited quarterly via DBT.
physicalCounter: Municipal Office (ULB) / Any CSC / Bank Branch
cscSteps: pmsvanidhi.mohua.gov.in → Login with Mobile OTP → Fill 1-Page Vendor Form → Select Preferred Bank Branch.

name: Gruha Lakshmi Direct Bank Transfer (₹2,000/Month)
ministry: Dept of Women & Child Development, Govt of Karnataka
benefitSummary: ₹2,000 every month (₹24,000/year) transferred directly into the bank account of the woman head of the family, plus free non-AC bus travel across the state under Shakti.
statutoryRule: Govt Order WCD 2023: Payable to ONE woman head listed on Ration Card. Excluded if woman or husband pays Income Tax or files GST returns.
commonRejectionTrap: Ration card e-KYC incomplete or bank account NPCI Aadhaar DBT mapper inactive.
criteriaList: Must be listed as the female Head of Family on an Antyodaya, BPL, or APL Ration Card.
Neither the woman nor her husband should be an Income Tax payer or GST filer.
Bank account must have active NPCI Aadhaar DBT seeding.
documents: Ration Card (Antyodaya / BPL / APL showing Woman Head)
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Book a free slot via Seva Sindhu or walk into your nearest GramaOne / KarnatakaOne / Bapuji Seva Kendra.
Step 2: Provide Ration Card number and complete biometric thumb/OTP authentication.
Step 3: Collect the printed Acknowledgement Slip (₹0 official government fee).
physicalCounter: GramaOne / KarnatakaOne / Bapuji Seva Kendra (₹0 Official Fee)
cscSteps: Open sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Click Gruha Lakshmi → Enter Ration Card No. → Verify Aadhaar OTP → Print Ack Slip.

name: Gruha Jyothi Free 200 Units Electricity Subsidy
ministry: Energy Department (BESCOM / MESCOM / HESCOM / GESCOM / CESC)
benefitType: Zero Electricity Bill up to 200 Units
benefitSummary: 100% free household electricity up to 200 units per month (saves ~₹14,400/year in cash for a typical family; tenants can also claim using rental agreement).
statutoryRule: Applicable to 1 domestic meter per household/Aadhaar (both house owners and rented-house tenants qualify).
commonRejectionTrap: Account ID / RR Number not linked with tenant/owner Aadhaar on Seva Sindhu.
criteriaList: Any residential electricity connection consuming under 200 units/month.
Both homeowners and tenants (using rental agreement/voter ID) can register.
One meter per Aadhaar card.
documents: Rental Agreement or Voter ID (if tenant)
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Visit sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Click 'Gruha Jyothi Scheme' (No login required).
Step 2: Select your ESCOM (BESCOM/HESCOM/etc.) and enter your 10-digit Account ID from your bill.
Step 3: Verify your Aadhaar via OTP—your next month's bill will automatically show ₹0.
physicalCounter: Any ESCOM Office, GramaOne, KarnatakaOne, or Apply on Mobile in 2 Mins
cscSteps: Open sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Click Gruha Jyothi → Select ESCOM Name → Enter Account ID → Link Aadhaar via OTP.

name: Anna Bhagya Cash DBT + PMGKAY Free Ration
ministry: Dept of Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs
benefitSummary: 5 kg free foodgrains per member under PMGKAY + ₹170/month per member direct bank cash transfer (approx ₹10,200/yr for a family).
statutoryRule: Mandatory monthly biometric thumb verification at Fair Price Shop (Ration Depot) + active BPL/Antyodaya card.
commonRejectionTrap: Head of family Aadhaar not linked with Food & Civil Supplies DBT server.
criteriaList: Must hold an active Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) or Priority Household (BPL) Ration Card.
All family members on the ration card must have completed Aadhaar e-KYC.
Head of household must have an NPCI-seeded bank account.
documents: Aadhaar Cards of All Family Members
selfApplySteps: Step 1: No separate application needed if your BPL card is active and e-KYC is done at your Ration Depot.
Step 2: To check if your cash is stuck, open ahara.kar.nic.in → E-Services → E-Status → DBT Status.
Step 3: If DBT shows failed, submit the Hakku NPCI Bank Mandate Form at your bank.
physicalCounter: Fair Price Shop (Ration Depot) / Food Inspector Office / GramaOne
cscSteps: Check DBT status at ahara.kar.nic.in → E-Services → E-Status → DBT Transfer Status → Enter Ration Card Number.

name: National Scholarship Portal (Central Post-Matric Scholarship)
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment / Minority Affairs
benefitSummary: ₹22,000/year tuition fee reimbursement + maintenance allowance credited straight to student's bank account.
statutoryRule: NSP OTR Guidelines: Student can hold only ONE Central Sector scholarship at a time. Family income ≤ ₹2.5L.
commonRejectionTrap: Aadhaar not seeded with NPCI mapper or Face-Auth OTR incomplete on NSP App.
criteriaList: Studying in Class 11, 12, Diploma, UG, PG, or Ph.D. in a recognized institution.
Annual family income ≤ ₹2,50,000.
Must belong to SC, ST, OBC, EWS, or Minority category.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Generate One-Time Registration (OTR) ID on scholarships.gov.in.
Step 2: Complete Face-Auth on the NSP Mobile App.
Step 3: Select Post-Matric Scholarship, enter RD numbers for Income/Caste, and submit.
physicalCounter: College Scholarship Nodal Desk / Any CSC / Cyber-Café
cscSteps: Login to scholarships.gov.in → Complete One-Time Registration (OTR) → Face Auth via NSP App → Select Post-Matric Scheme → Upload RD Certificate.

name: PM-USP Central Sector Scholarship & Education Loan Interest Waiver
ministry: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
benefitType: Direct Cash Scholarship + CSIS 100% Education Loan Interest Subsidy
benefitSummary: ₹12,000–₹20,000/yr scholarship PLUS a hidden gem: under PM-USP CSIS, the Central Govt pays 100% of the interest on education loans up to ₹10 Lakh during the entire study + moratorium period!
statutoryRule: Family income below ₹4.5 Lakh qualifies for both PM-USP scholarship and 100% education loan interest subsidy via Jansamarth portal.
commonRejectionTrap: Not submitting the Income Certificate (< ₹4.5L) to the education loan bank to activate CSIS zero-interest moratorium.
criteriaList: Regular college/university student with family income ≤ ₹4,50,000.
Eligible across ALL categories (General, OBC, SC, ST, EWS).
For Education Loan Interest Waiver: apply via jansamarth.in.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: For the ₹12k–₹20k cash scholarship, apply on scholarships.gov.in under 'Department of Higher Education'.
Step 2: For the 100% Education Loan Interest Subsidy (CSIS), visit jansamarth.in → Education Loan → Check Subsidy Eligibility.
physicalCounter: College Nodal Officer / Jansamarth Portal / Bank Branch
cscSteps: scholarships.gov.in → Student Login → Dept of Higher Education → PM-USP Central Sector Scheme (and jansamarth.in for Loan Interest Waiver).

name: State SSP & Vidyasiri Food/Hostel Stipend (₹15,000/Yr)
ministry: Backward Classes / Social Welfare Dept, Govt of Karnataka
benefitSummary: ₹1,500/month for 10 months (₹15,000/yr) for day-scholar/PG students + government college fee reimbursement.
statutoryRule: Karnataka Sakala Act SLA: 21 Working Days. Can be legally stacked with non-conflicting fee concessions.
commonRejectionTrap: Name spelling mismatch between SSLC marksheet and Aadhaar Card.
criteriaList: Post-matric student studying in Karnataka from SC, ST, OBC, or EWS family.
Annual family income below ₹2,50,000.
Not residing in a free government hostel (to claim ₹15,000 Vidyasiri food/accommodation cash).
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Open ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in and login with your SSP ID.
Step 2: Enter your Nadakacheri RD Number and College Registration Number.
Step 3: Complete e-Attestation if in degree/engineering and submit.
physicalCounter: GramaOne / Cyber-Café + College SSP Nodal Officer
cscSteps: ssp.postmatric.karnataka.gov.in → Create SSP Account → Enter RD Number from Nadakacheri → e-Attestation by College Officer.

name: Yuva Nidhi Graduate & Diploma Allowance (₹3,000/Month)
ministry: Dept of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship & Livelihood
benefitSummary: ₹3,000/month (₹36,000/year) for unemployed Degree graduates and ₹1,500/month for Diploma holders for up to 2 years until employed.
statutoryRule: Candidate must submit monthly self-declaration on Seva Sindhu before the 25th confirming they are not in full-time PF-paying employment.
commonRejectionTrap: Forgetting to submit the monthly 1-click self-declaration between the 1st and 25th of each month.
criteriaList: Degree or Diploma graduate who has been unemployed for 6+ months after passing.
Studied minimum 6 years in Karnataka.
Not currently enrolled in higher full-time studies or drawing EPFO/ESI salary.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Login to sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in and search 'Yuva Nidhi'.
Step 2: Enter your University Registration Number for automatic NAD verification.
Step 3: Every month before the 25th, click 'Yuva Nidhi Self-Declaration' so your ₹3,000 does not pause.
physicalCounter: GramaOne / KarnatakaOne / District Employment Exchange
cscSteps: sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Yuva Nidhi Scheme → Verify University Registration No. → Submit Monthly Self-Declaration.

name: PM Vishwakarma Grant (₹15,000 Toolkit + ₹500/Day Stipend)
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small & Medium Enterprises (MSME)
benefitType: Free Toolkit Grant + Training Cash + 5% Loan
benefitSummary: ₹15,000 free e-voucher for modern tools (sewing machine, carpenter/mason/mechanic kit) + ₹500/day training stipend (~₹3,500) + collateral-free ₹1L–₹3L loan at 5% interest.
statutoryRule: Open to 18 self-employed trades (tailors, carpenters, masons, mechanics, barbers, goldsmiths, washermen, potters, garland makers). One member per family.
commonRejectionTrap: Trying to apply on a home phone—PM Vishwakarma strictly requires CSC operator biometric login.
criteriaList: Minimum age 18 years engaged in any of the 18 eligible artisan/service trades (including tailoring at home).
Have not availed PMEGP or Mudra loan in the last 5 years.
No family member in regular government service.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Carry your Aadhaar, Ration Card, and Bank Passbook to the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC).
Step 2: Complete biometric fingerprint authentication on pmvishwakarma.gov.in (₹0 registration cost—government pays the CSC).
Step 3: Attend the 5-day local skill verification to receive ₹2,500 cash stipend + ₹15,000 e-RUPI toolkit voucher.
physicalCounter: MUST Visit Nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) — Free Registration
cscSteps: Visit CSC → Operator logs into pmvishwakarma.gov.in → Biometric Auth → Select Trade (e.g. Tailor/Carpenter/Mason) → Gram Panchayat Verification.

name: PM-KISAN Samman Nidhi (₹6,000/Year Cash)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefitSummary: ₹6,000/year in 3 equal installments of ₹2,000 transferred directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank account.
statutoryRule: PM-KISAN Para 4: Income Tax payers and regular Govt employees are statutorily excluded.
commonRejectionTrap: e-KYC incomplete or Land Seeding marked 'NO' in Revenue/Bhoomi records.
criteriaList: Cultivable agricultural landholder with RTC / Pahani in their name.
Non-income-tax payer.
Aadhaar e-KYC and NPCI Bank Seeding completed.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Open pmkisan.gov.in → Click 'New Farmer Registration' or 'e-KYC'.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar number and FRUITS / Land Survey RTC details.
Step 3: Check 'Know Your Status' to confirm Land Seeding = YES and Aadhaar Bank Seeding = YES.
physicalCounter: Raitha Samparka Kendra / CSC / GramaOne
cscSteps: pmkisan.gov.in → Farmers Corner → Complete OTP/Biometric e-KYC → Verify Land Seeding = YES & Aadhaar Bank Seeding = YES.

name: Ganga Kalyana Free Borewell & Pump Electrification Grant (₹3.5L–₹4.75L Grant)
ministry: Backward Classes (DBCDC) / SC-ST / Minorities Development Corporations
benefitType: 100% Free Borewell Drilling + Submersible Pump + ESCOM Energization
benefitSummary: Small and marginal farmers (1.5 to 5 acres) get a 100% government-funded irrigation borewell, pump set, and ₹75,000 electricity connection worth ₹3.5L–₹4.75L (amortized ₹35,000/yr value).
statutoryRule: Farmer must be a small/marginal landholder without an existing working irrigation borewell on that survey number.
commonRejectionTrap: FRUITS Farmer ID (FID) not linked with Caste & Income RD number before applying on Suvarna / Seva Sindhu.
criteriaList: Small or marginal farmer owning 1.5 to 5 acres of dry agricultural land.
Annual family income below ₹1,20,000.
Valid FRUITS ID from Raitha Samparka Kendra.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Obtain your 16-digit FRUITS ID at your local Raitha Samparka Kendra.
Step 2: Visit sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Search 'Ganga Kalyana Scheme'.
Step 3: Enter FRUITS ID and Nadakacheri RD Number to auto-fetch land records and submit.
physicalCounter: GramaOne / District Corporation Office (DBCDC / Adi Jambava / KMDC)
cscSteps: sevasindhuservices.karnataka.gov.in → Ganga Kalyana Irrigation Scheme → Enter FRUITS FID & RD Number → Submit Online.

name: PM-KUSUM Solar Pump 60% Govt Subsidy
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE)
benefitSummary: Up to 60% government grant on solar irrigation pumps (saves ~₹45,000/yr in diesel and electricity expenses).
statutoryRule: MNRE PM-KUSUM Guidelines: 30% Central + 30% State subsidy; farmer pays only 10% upfront (30% bank loan).
commonRejectionTrap: Applying through fake private websites instead of official state nodal portal (KREDL / pmkusum.mnre.gov.in).
criteriaList: Farmer owning agricultural land with water source (borewell/open well/farm pond).
Must apply only through official MNRE / KREDL state portal.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Visit pmkusum.mnre.gov.in or souramitra.com (KREDL Karnataka portal).
Step 2: Register with FRUITS ID and select pump capacity (3 HP to 10 HP).
Step 3: Pay only your beneficiary share after official work order is issued.
physicalCounter: State Renewable Energy Nodal Office (KREDL) / Raitha Samparka Kendra
cscSteps: Apply ONLY via pmkusum.mnre.gov.in or State Nodal Portal when district quota opens.

name: PM Fasal Bima Yojana (85% Govt-Paid Crop Shield)
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
benefitSummary: Government pays ~85% of premium; farmer pays only 1.5%–2% for full financial payout on drought, flood, or pest loss.
statutoryRule: Localised calamity/hailstorm loss must be reported within 72 hours on Crop Insurance App or 14447 helpline.
commonRejectionTrap: Crop name mismatch between RTC Pahani crop survey and bank portal entry.
criteriaList: All farmers (both loanee and non-loanee) growing notified Kharif/Rabi crops.
Crop entry on RTC Pahani must match the insured crop.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Visit pmfby.gov.in or samrakshane.karnataka.gov.in before the seasonal cutoff.
Step 2: Enter Survey Number and select insured crop.
Step 3: Pay the nominal 1.5%–2% farmer share and download the Policy Certificate.
physicalCounter: Raitha Samparka Kendra / Rural Bank Branch / CSC
cscSteps: pmfby.gov.in → Farmer Application → Select Season (Kharif/Rabi) → Enter Survey Number → Get Policy Receipt.

name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) 4% Interest Subvention Grant
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture / RBI
benefitSummary: Working capital up to ₹3 Lakh at just 4% effective interest (Govt pays 3% interest subvention bonus on timely repayment, saving ~₹15,000/yr; also open to dairy & fishery farmers).
statutoryRule: RBI Circular: Banks must waive processing/inspection charges for KCC limits up to ₹3 Lakh and issue decision within 14 days.
commonRejectionTrap: Missing prompt repayment window, which forfeits the 3% government interest subsidy.
criteriaList: Owner cultivator, tenant farmer, dairy farmer, or poultry/fishery farmer aged 18–75.
Zero collateral security required up to ₹1.60 Lakh limit.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Download the 1-page PM-KISAN KCC form from pmkisan.gov.in.
Step 2: Submit at the bank branch where your PM-KISAN installment is credited.
Step 3: Under RBI rules, the bank must process it within 14 working days with ₹0 processing fee.
physicalCounter: Nearest Nationalised / Rural / Cooperative Bank Branch
cscSteps: Download KCC 1-page form from pmkisan.gov.in → Submit at Bank Branch where PM-KISAN is credited.

name: NSAP Old Age Pension + Sandhya Suraksha (₹14,400/Yr)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / Directorate of Social Security
benefitSummary: ₹1,200/month (₹14,400/year) lifetime monthly pension credited straight to bank or post office account for seniors 60+.
statutoryRule: Social Security Pension Rules: A citizen can draw only ONE social security pension (Old Age OR Widow) at a time.
commonRejectionTrap: Annual Life Certificate (Jeevan Pramaan) biometric e-KYC not renewed.
criteriaList: Age 60 years or above.
BPL household or annual income below ₹1,20,000.
Not receiving any other public/government pension.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Visit Nadakacheri / GramaOne or apply on sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in.
Step 2: Village Accountant completes field verification within 21 Sakala working days.
Step 3: Pension starts crediting every month via India Post Payments Bank or NPCI Bank Account.
physicalCounter: Nadakacheri / GramaOne / Taluk Office
cscSteps: sevasindhu.karnataka.gov.in / Nadakacheri → Sandhya Suraksha / IGNOAPS → Village Accountant Field Verification within 21 Sakala days.

name: Indira Gandhi Destitute Widow Pension (₹14,400/Yr)
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development / State Social Security Dept
benefitSummary: ₹1,200/month (₹14,400/year) direct monthly pension for widows from low-income households.
statutoryRule: Mutually exclusive with Old-Age Pension under NSAP rules; Hakku prevents duplicate pension filing that triggers recovery notices.
commonRejectionTrap: Husband's Death Certificate registration number not verified on e-JanMa portal.
criteriaList: Widow aged 18 years or above.
Annual household income below ₹1,50,000 / BPL family.
Valid Death Certificate of late spouse.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Apply at Nadakacheri / GramaOne with Aadhaar and Husband's Death Certificate.
Step 2: Track status using your 15-digit Nadakacheri Ack Number.
Step 3: Sanction order is issued within 21 working days under Sakala Act.
physicalCounter: Nadakacheri / GramaOne / Seva Sindhu Counter
cscSteps: Nadakacheri / Seva Sindhu → Destitute Widow Pension → Attach Death Certificate & Ration Card.

name: PM Matru Vandana Yojana (₹5,000–₹6,000 Maternity Cash)
ministry: Ministry of Women & Child Development
benefitSummary: ₹5,000 cash transfer for first child and ₹6,000 lump sum for second girl child under PMMVY 2.0 directly to mother's bank account.
statutoryRule: Must have MCP (Mother and Child Protection / Thayi) Card registered at local Anganwadi / Primary Health Centre.
commonRejectionTrap: Delay in registering pregnancy at Anganwadi beyond 150 days.
criteriaList: Pregnant and lactating women aged 19+ from BPL / e-Shram / PM-JAY / low-income households.
MCP (Thayi) Card registered at local Anganwadi or Govt Hospital.
documents: BPL Card / e-Shram Card / Income Proof
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Visit pmmvy.wcd.gov.in and click 'Citizen Login' using your mobile number.
Step 2: Enter your MCP Card details and upload Aadhaar + Bank Passbook.
Step 3: Alternatively, hand the documents to your local ASHA / Anganwadi worker for free entry.
physicalCounter: Local Anganwadi Centre / Primary Health Centre (PHC) / GramaOne
cscSteps: pmmvy.wcd.gov.in → Citizen Login → Fill Form 1-A using MCP Card Date → Anganwadi Supervisor Approval.

name: PM Awas Yojana Housing Grant (₹1,20,000–₹2,50,000 Total)
deadlineLabel: 🟢 NEW • PMAY 2.0 Urban & Rural Survey Open
ministry: Ministry of Housing & Urban Affairs / Rural Development
benefitSummary: ₹1,20,000 (Rural PMAY-G) to ₹2,50,000 (Urban PMAY-U 2.0) direct grant in 3–4 geo-tagged installments to build a pucca house (amortized ~₹30,000/yr value).
statutoryRule: Beneficiary family must not own an existing pucca house anywhere in India; female ownership or joint ownership is mandatory.
commonRejectionTrap: Starting foundation work before the Panchayat/Municipal engineer takes the Stage-0 empty-site Geo-Tag photo.
criteriaList: Family does not own a pucca (cement/brick roof) house anywhere in India.
Possesses a house site / kutcha house document (E-Swathu / Khata / Hakku Patra).
House registration includes female head or joint ownership.
selfApplySteps: Step 1: For Urban, apply directly on pmaymis.gov.in under PMAY-U 2.0 Citizen Survey.
Step 2: For Rural, submit application at your Gram Panchayat under PMAY-G / Basava Vasathi Yojana.
Step 3: Ensure Stage-0 Geo-Tagging is done before laying the foundation so your 1st installment releases smoothly.
physicalCounter: Gram Panchayat (PMAY-G) / Municipal Corporation Office (PMAY-U)
cscSteps: pmaymis.gov.in / pmayg.nic.in → Citizen Assessment → Apply under Beneficiary-Led Construction (BLC).

name: Ayushman Bharat PM-JAY + 70+ Senior Vay Vandana (₹5 Lakh Cover)
deadlineLabel: 🟢 NEW • Universal 70+ Senior Card Live (No Income Limit!)
ministry: National Health Authority (NHA), Ministry of Health
benefitSummary: ₹5,00,000/year free cashless treatment at 29,000+ public & private hospitals—PLUS a hidden gem: every senior citizen aged 70+ now gets ₹5L free cover regardless of rich/poor income status!
statutoryRule: NHA 2024 Amendment: All senior citizens aged 70+ qualify solely on Aadhaar age proof with ZERO income limit; BPL/priority families covered at all ages.
commonRejectionTrap: Waiting until a medical emergency instead of pre-downloading the Ayushman Golden Card on beneficiary.nha.gov.in.
criteriaList: All BPL / Priority Ration Card families (any age) get ₹5 Lakh/year family cover.
HIDDEN GEM: ANY senior citizen aged 70+ (even from middle-class or tax-paying families) gets a dedicated ₹5 Lakh Ayushman Vay Vandana Card using ONLY Aadhaar!
documents: Aadhaar Card (Only document needed for 70+ Seniors!)
Ration Card / Family ID (for general family enrollment)
selfApplySteps: Step 1: Open beneficiary.nha.gov.in on your phone or download the 'Ayushman App'.
Step 2: Login as Beneficiary using your mobile OTP.
Step 3: Click the '70+ Senior Citizen Enrollment' banner (or search by Ration Card), complete Aadhaar OTP e-KYC, and download your ₹5 Lakh card in 3 minutes.
physicalCounter: Any Hospital Ayushman Mitra Desk / GramaOne / Self-Apply on Phone
cscSteps: beneficiary.nha.gov.in → Login with Mobile → Search by Ration Card or 70+ Senior Enrollment → e-KYC → Download Ayushman Card.
